name: Card
description: A raised surface that groups related content, such as a summary, a settings group or a list item.

values.name: elevated
values.description: Stronger shadow to lift the card above its neighbors.

values.name: bordered
values.description: Border only, no shadow; for flat, dense layouts.

values.name: interactive
values.description: The whole card is clickable; shows hover feedback.

elements.name: header
elements.description: Top area; holds the title and optional badges.

elements.name: title
elements.description: Card heading. Use the heading level that fits the page outline.

elements.name: footer
elements.description: Bottom area for actions or metadata; has a top divider.

children: Elements appear in the order header, body, footer. All are optional.

use: Place cards in l-grid or l-stack; the layout sets the gap between cards.
For c-card--interactive, make the card an <a> or put one link inside whose area covers the card.
avoid: Putting several competing links inside a c-card--interactive.

a11y: An interactive card must be reachable with the keyboard: use a real <a> or <button>, never a click handler on a <div>.
Keep the title a real heading so screen reader users can navigate by headings.
